verdict.rationale: As the reference OpenAI API, the platform supports existing OpenAI-style tooling: official SDKs, any preferred HTTP client, and continued support for Chat Completions alongside the newer Responses API. However, the only documented migration path is internal (Chat Completions to Responses), with no adapter or migration guidance from other providers' SDKs. missing for 10: documented migration/adapter path from other providers' SDKs, explicit statement of compatibility with third-party OpenAI-compatible tooling, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible tooling at the platform, or follow a documented migration/adapter path from other providers' SDKs

citations.quote: While Chat Completions remains supported, Responses is recommended for all new projects.
official SDKs for application code, the OpenAI CLI for shell-native workflows, the Agents SDK for orchestration, or your own preferred HTTP client
The OpenAI Python library provides convenient access to the OpenAI REST API from any Python 3.10+ application.
